rule: R2 passes when the judged share is no lower than the control share minus quality.jury.maxShareGap (0.2)
note: It passes by the rule with both shares at nought: no juror took a picture of the build or an approved image for a photograph or a film frame. What the rule does not see: the build's two pictures from the home camera drew (d) from all ten jurors, the approved key from the same camera drew (d) from two of five and (c) from three. The words of the jurors on the judged pictures are input for the next round.
